task: Na webovej stránke nájdi stránku s kontaktnými údajmi. Otvor ju a vypíš e-mailovú adresu a telefónne číslo na zákaznícku podporu alebo reklamácie tovaru.

goalSpec.goal: Na webovej stránke nájdi stránku s kontaktnými údajmi, otvor ju a vypíš e-mailovú adresu a telefónne číslo na zákaznícku podporu alebo reklamácie tovaru.
successCriteria: Cookie banner is no longer visible.
The page showing contact details is open.
An email address for customer support or complaints has been identified.
A phone number for customer support or complaints has been identified.
goalSpec.stopCondition: An email address and a phone number for customer support or complaints have been successfully extracted and provided as an answer.
assumptions: The website has a dedicated contact page.
The contact page contains an email address and a phone number.

subtasks.title: Accept the cookie policy to ensure full page access.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cookie consent overlay is no longer visible.

subtasks.title: Locate a link to the contact page, or a page likely to contain contact information (e.g., 'Kontakt', 'O nás', 'Informácie').
subtasks.doneWhen: A suitable link to the contact page has been identified.

subtasks.title: Click on the identified link to navigate to the contact details page.
subtasks.doneWhen: The browser is on the page displaying contact details.

subtasks.title: Identify and extract the e-mail address and phone number for customer support or complaints from the contact page.
subtasks.doneWhen: The email address and phone number have been successfully extracted.

finalVerdict: Na stránke Dekanát sú uvedené kontaktné údaje tajomníčky fakulty. E-mailová adresa je tajomnik[at]fiit.stuba.sk a telefónne číslo je +421 2 210 22 203. Nie je explicitne uvedený kontakt na zákaznícku podporu alebo reklamácie.
